observations.behavior: Replaces the previous endpoint and primary key configuration with a typed, frozen dataclass and a dictionary of endpoint configurations, including dependent endpoints with fan-out relationships.
observations.posthog_connection: Defines the complete set of API endpoints and their metadata for the Clarifai warehouse source, including dependent relationships and pagination settings.

observations.behavior: Adds a new endpoint configuration for annotations with a parameter to list all annotations, and an endpoint for evaluations with a parameter to show failed metrics.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds support for importing annotations and evaluation metrics, including failed ones, into warehouse tables.

observations.behavior: Adds a fan-out dependent endpoint configuration for dataset inputs, linking to the parent datasets endpoint, and a fan-out dependent endpoint for model versions, linking to the parent models endpoint.
observations.posthog_connection: Implements hierarchical data ingestion by fetching parent records first, then using parent IDs to fetch dependent records, supporting warehouse tables with composite primary keys.
